event.loss: some scrap metals were stolen however, the exact quantity remains undetermined

sources.title: Piracy monthly report November 2025
sources.text: While underway, the master of HK TUG 9 reported to VTIS Centre that four sampans, carrying an estimated of three unauthorised persons, came alongside the towed barge LKH 7887 and removed scrap metal. The perpetrators did not board the barge. The incident occurred during the ships’ voyage from Singapore to Vietnam.
